summary: Steward subsystem setup: when StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_3, 2330) returns non-zero, writes the 'Entered Steward' debug message via DebugLogWrite into the dword_8AD25C buffer; then registers the Vehicle, Timing and Pitstop subsystems through sub_5599D0/sub_559A00 with TimerFrameRateThrottle and TrackTemperatureDisplay as handler callbacks. Returns the result of the last sub_559A00 registration call. Called by Game_Setup (0042D5D0).

operations.description: Call StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_3, 2330) as a debug-message gate.
When StringSplitLoop returns non-zero, emit the 'Entered Steward' debug message.
Call DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredSteward) to log the debug entry message into the message buffer.
Register the Timing subsystem: sub_559A00(aTiming, TimerFrameRateThrottle, 0) with TimerFrameRateThrottle as the handler callback.
Register the Pitstop subsystem: sub_559A00(aPitstop, TrackTemperatureDisplay, 0) with TrackTemperatureDisplay as the handler callback.
Return the result of the last sub_559A00 call (the Pitstop registration). Game_Setup (0042D5D0) is the caller.
